speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn; to begin our consultation, how long has it been since you were born, and have you had any fever, difficulty breathing, or poor feeding?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for those details. Given the lack of prenatal care and immunization records, are you aware of the mother's vaccination status, specifically for Rubella, Hepatitis B, or Varicella? Also, has the newborn received the Vitamin K shot and the first dose of the Hepatitis B vaccine within 24 hours of birth?
